# QR Take-Home Data Project & Presentation

[← Optiver](../README.md) · [Every Optiver question](../../optiver.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/qr-take-home-data-project)

`data-analysis` `pandas` `presentation`

---

## Requirements

- After the initial technical interviews, candidates receive a take-home data exercise: they must analyze or model the supplied data and turn in their findings, with some reporting methods as basic as linear regression.
- Those who progress, frequently within roughly two days, enter a **presentation round** where they explain the project thoroughly and answer focused questions about their methodology, time-series treatment, and use of pandas.

## Notes

- A decision or invitation to present usually arrives within a few days, although some candidates experience a longer wait.
- The presentation includes detailed follow-up questions about data manipulation — candidates say they faced intensive questioning on pandas syntax and time-series specifics, so understand your complete pipeline and be prepared to justify your modeling decisions.
- The evaluation values clear reasoning and command of the tools alongside the model's raw performance.

## Preparation

- Become comfortable with pandas and time-series processes such as resampling, rolling statistics, returns, and joins, allowing you to discuss implementation without consulting documentation.
- Organize a concise explanation of your take-home covering the problem definition, model rationale, validation, and limitations, then practice defending every choice.
